svg.aria-label: The window while a file is dragged over it, and the lines for each kind of drop
svg.text: Drop to start a new project with demo-shaft.step
New project opens with the name "demo-shaft"; the import window follows OK.

g.text: What the line says, by what is dragged:
• a model, a project open: "Drop to import demo-shaft.step"
• a model, no project open: "Drop to start a new project with demo-shaft.step" (above)
• a project folder or its project.toml: "Drop to open the project baluster-project"
• several: the first usable one, with "(1 of 3; the rest are not imported)"
• anything else: "OpenChuckCAM imports STL and STEP files and opens project folders"
